Every role, flow v2 (design-v2 sections 4 and 13). run.mjs open copies this into run.json; fill brief, lane_reason, done_means and every task placeholder before the first dispatch.
lane_reason: <orchestrator: why this lane, from the files the change touches>

<orchestrator: this run's architecture task> Write the ADR and the task briefs brief-frontend.md and brief-backend.md.
accept: Each brief names its inputs, outputs and acceptance criteria
The ADR names every invariant the change touches and where it is enforced

Every colour, spacing, radius, duration and type size traced to a BRAND.md token

npm run db:test green, its log under evidence/backend/

accept: Screenshots at 320, 360, 768, 1024 and 1440, both themes, English and Arabic, under evidence/frontend/
lint, typecheck, test and build green in every touched workspace

plan.task: Senior review of the makers' change at the latest snapshot: problem fit, layer boundaries, failure modes, test quality, rollout safety. Independent of the other three reviews.
Line-by-line defect, data-layer and structural scan of the makers' change at the latest snapshot. Independent of the other three reviews.
Readability and maintainability review of the makers' change at the latest snapshot: names, size, module headers, comments that say why. Independent of the other three reviews.
Security sweep of the makers' change at the latest snapshot per actio-security, npm audit and the Supabase advisors included. Independent of the three reviews.
Regression guard: node .actio/bin/bugs.mjs guard for this run on the makers' snapshot. Runs beside the four reviews, not after them; re-run on each new snapshot.
Integration gate: node .actio/bin/verify.mjs once for the snapshot, conformance to the ADR, migrate, exercise the seam end to end, get_advisors clean or accepted in writing.
Test the change: API contract, privacy invariants, state machine, flows, accessibility, four locales, both themes, e2e. Reuse the verify bundle for the same tree. Evidence under evidence/qc/.
Audit qc-engineer's evidence, name the untested surface, probe the highest blast-radius path yourself, and issue go or no-go as the quality gate.

Release: pre-flight, rollback.md before the first migration, migrations through the Supabase MCP verified with list_migrations, get_advisors clean, build green, tag, push to origin main, post-release smoke. Hosting recorded as deferred: no target chosen.
Record pass: every product-code defect from this run into BUGS.md with its standing rule; ids from bugs.mjs next-id, the Open index from bugs.mjs open-index.
